description: Use this when the user asks to create a responsibility-style Familia task, agreement, reminder, or chore. If the same task repeats across several days, weeks, or months, provide repeatRule and create one recurring task instead of multiple one-time tasks. Do not use for calendar-style events, trips, school activities, or holidays; use familia_create_plan instead. When the primary intent is a shopping list, packing list, or standalone checklist, use familia_create_list_task. Assigning to another household member queues a push notification; schedules can also queue reminders, and delivered notifications cannot be recalled.

allDay.description: Whether the due date is an all-day task.

assigneeUserId.description: Optional Familia user id responsible for the task.

description.description: Optional task details, notes, or context.

dueAt.description: Accepts YYYY-MM-DD for all-day items or an RFC 3339 datetime. When using a datetime without an offset, provide timezone.

householdId.description: Familia household id where the task should be created.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional stable retry key. Reusing the same key for the same create operation returns the original result instead of creating a duplicate.

leadMinutes.description: Reminder lead time in minutes before dueAt. Defaults to 0.

ownerUserId.description: Optional Familia user id that owns the task.

recurrenceEndDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD end date for a recurring schedule. Use this for bounded repeats such as "this week", "for three days", or "until Sunday".

repeatRule.description: Optional RFC 5545 RRULE, e.g. FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=2 or FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE. Use this when the user says the same task or plan repeats across days, weeks, or months; create one recurring schedule instead of multiple one-time items unless each occurrence has different content. Requires the first dueAt/startAt as the anchor.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for dueAt, e.g. Europe/Prague.

title.description: Short task title, e.g. "Pay school fee" or "Take bins out".

todoList.description: Optional checklist/list to attach to the created task.

name: familia_create_task
title: Create task
